name: BBW Telecom
summary: Hobart wireless telco (Broadband Wireless Pty Ltd); acquired Intas 2009; absorbed by iiNet directly ~late Feb 2012.

events.details: Founded in Hobart (to serve Thrifty Car Rental franchise); earliest Wayback capture 20 Sep 2003 (bbw.net.au).
Absorbed by iiNet directly (per user report; no public announcement); bbw.net.au homepage froze at ©2011 'Broadband Wireless Pty Ltd' content and lingered as a static page to ~2021.
